verdict.rationale: Whether a remote-desktop service uses customer data for AI training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no AI-training policy or opt-out control. 'Privacy mode' and the peer-to-peer claim (connections 'never pass through Parsec's infrastructure') are related privacy features, not a documented guarantee against training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
